solution.summary: In this work, we propose the first unified endto-end sensor fusion framework for 3D detection, named FUTR3D, which can be used in (almost) any sensor configuration. • We design a Modality-Agnostic Feature Sampler, called MAFS.
solution.approach: In this work, we propose the first unified endto-end sensor fusion framework for 3D detection, named FUTR3D, which can be used in (almost) any sensor configuration.

evidence.quote: In this work, we propose the first unified endto-end sensor fusion framework for 3D detection, named FUTR3D, which can be used in (almost) any sensor configuration.
• We design a Modality-Agnostic Feature Sampler, called MAFS.
MAFS enables our method to operate on any sensors and their combinations in a modality agnostic way.

experiments.summary: On NuScenes dataset, FUTR3D achieves better performance over specifically designed methods across different sensor combinations. Moreover, FUTR3D achieves great flexibility with different sensor configurations and enables low-cost autonomous driving.

evidence.quote: On NuScenes dataset, FUTR3D achieves better performance over specifically designed methods across different sensor combinations.

limitations.summary: Also, it does not require post-processing, thanks to the set prediction module.
items: Also, it does not require post-processing, thanks to the set prediction module.
Since our framework does not make assumptions about the modalities used or their model architectures, our model works with any choices of feature encoders.
The initial reference point does not depend on features from any sensors, and it will update dynamically after fusing features from all modalities.
PointPainting uses extra image data from nuImages to pre-train its image segmentation models while our method does not include any additional data.
